messages:
elaine (sales): FYI customer POC is failing JSON validation when using tool calls + json_mode. stack: acme. They hit it during a 5k-record import.
acme-bob (customer): repro: model sometimes returns valid JSON then appends a short explanation, e.g. `{\"result\": [...]}\nNote: I pasted the raw output in case it's helpful`
ajay (solutions): can you paste the exact raw output and request_id? that helps triage.
acme-bob (customer): request_id=rid_9ab3d, raw: ```{\"items\": [ {\"id\": \"1\", \"status\": \"ok\"} ]}\nSome commentary: truncated for brevity```
taylor (eng-runtime): ugh pattern seen this week — streaming + json_mode can leave trailing commentary if the model generation isn't constrained. also need to check for truncation / partial flush.
ci-bot: Deploy notice: runtime:canary v0.9.12 rolled at 2024-06-11 04:12 UTC :rocket:
ajay (solutions): two things to check quickly: 1) are you using strict json enforcement header? set `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` 2) did you see any 429s in the same time window?
acme-bob (customer): saw a few 429 spikes, here are excerpts from our logs:
```
2024-06-11T16:52:01Z ERROR request rid_9ab3d 429 TooManyRequests qps=35 limit=30
2024-06-11T16:52:02Z WARN response-snippet rid_9ab3d partial-output "{\"items\": [{\"id\": \"1\", \"status\": \"ok\"}]}\nSome commentary"
```
elaine (sales): customer asks if this is a pricing/capacity issue — they may need higher QPS for the POC window. what are options?
ajay (solutions): short answer: bump to Dedicated burst or increase hosted rate limit for the evaluation. pricing: short-term QPS bump we can offer via add-on (sales/ops) or recommend Dedicated commit for sustained. ping @sales-ops for pricing details.
taylor (eng-runtime): on the runtime side, immediate mitigations: - enforce strict json_mode header - enable `sanitize_trailing_text=true` on the route (patches off last non-json tokens) - add `max_tokens` guard so model doesn't append long commentary - fallback: stream until closing brace `}` and verify checksum client-side
ajay (solutions): also suggest adding a post-process retry: if parse fails and status code != 429, do a single immediate retry with `prefer_json=true` and jittered backoff. that handles transient model noise.
sam (security): quick sec ask from acme: if we enable dedicated burst, what logs are retained and where? they need 1 year retention for audit. also need confirmation that PII won't be stored in logs.
elaine (sales): acme priority: compliance is blocker.\taylor (eng-runtime): Dedicated routes can be configured with Private logging off (no request bodies persisted) or with redacted logs. retention negotiable via enterprise contract; default hosted retention is 30d. I'll DM infra to confirm HSM/KMS for keys.
ajay (solutions): next steps for the customer: 1) push strict header, 2) enable sanitize_trailing_text, 3) run a small reproduce with 10k tokens to confirm. if 429 still appears, we escalate to capacity team for temp QPS bump.
acme-bob (customer): doing step 1+2 now, will report in ~30m. thanks.
elaine (sales): I'll loop in sales-ops and legal on retention once we get repro. thanks all. :thumbsup:
acme-bob (customer): follow-up: after sanitize + strict header the parser passes on 95% of cases, still seeing ~5% with trailing ellipses and sometimes a truncated last object. sending new sample rid_9ab4e.
taylor (eng-runtime): ok send rid_9ab4e logs; if it's truncated we should increase `completion.buffer_size` and opt for atomic response mode. also add server-side validator that rejects responses not ending with '}' before handing to customer. this avoids partial JSON leaks.
ajay (solutions): I'll prepare a short runbook for the customer with the header settings, retry snippet, and pricing notes. will attach to this thread when ready.
elaine (sales): great. will also include an estimate for a short-term QPS bump pricing vs Dedicated commit.
ci-bot: Incident tracker updated: ticket #SR-2024-778 created for capacity review.
